name: green

attributes.attribute: the color most loved by the fairies
tied to abundance and the land

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Green is the symbolic color most favored by the fairy races of the Celtic lands, together with red. Many people in Scotland refused to wear green so as not to offend their fairy neighbors. The color points to fresh growth and to the fairies as earlier spirits of fruitfulness.

okr.objective: Present green as the color the fairy races favored.
key_results: Green and red held the fairy favor.
The color warns of fairy fruitfulness.
okr.evidence: Monaghan, The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore, 2003
